scope: Independent pixel review of five requested production PNGs, plus the same-run pump result PNG to investigate initially blank vehicle cards. Verdict covers the original clipping, hit-area, arrow containment, slot overlap and scroll defects.

findings.observed: Initial and pump target, label, listen control and choice card frames remain within their scene/viewport; enabled controls measure at least 44 CSS px and hit-test successfully. The subsequent pump result and chosen worker remain within the stage.
All four directional images are visibly contained in their buttons, command slots do not overlap controls, and the measurements report no issue.
Seven distinct command slots are visible above the arrow controls in the top capture. The bottom capture reveals Undo, Clear and GO. The measured touch-scroll transition is 0 to maximum 170.

captureCaveat.observation: construction-640x360-pump.png shows three empty vehicle cards. The subsequent construction-640x360-result.png visibly shows all three vehicle images plus the selected pump worker.
captureCaveat.inference: The helper captures the pump frame immediately after its DOM transition without waiting for image decode; the later image visibility is consistent with a loading-time capture rather than persistent missing assets.
captureCaveat.limit: The original blank pump frame is not certified as visually complete, and exact image loading latency is not measured. Browser source response evidence covers application source files, not individual vehicle asset decode.
captureCaveat.releaseScopeAssessment: No blocker for the original small-screen clipping or touch-flow scope. Preserve both original frames and use decoded-image captures in Stage 4 visual review.

limitations: Six PNGs were visually reviewed, not every frame or viewport.
Chromium touch emulation and simulated audio completion; physical device and speaker audio NOT_RUN.
Service-worker upgrade behavior in an already installed client is not certified by this service-workers-blocked browser run.
Remaining unrelated regression workflows and final release coordination belong to the parent task.
